name: fluentvalidation-review-hard
request: This branch lets customers register with a delivery address and change their profile (PUT /customers/{id}), and moves the customer requests to FluentValidation. Review it before we merge it.

assertions.judge: The review finds at least 7 of the 9 planted mistakes.
The review finds every planted mistake with severity 'high' (P1, P3, P7).
The review flags none of the decoys (D1 to D4) as a problem and asks to change none of them.

At most 3 findings are false positives. A false positive is a claim that is wrong, a finding on a decoy, or a fix that would break the code or that uses an API that does not exist or is outdated. A real problem that is not on the planted list is not a false positive.
Each finding gives the file and the line (or quotes the code) and a concrete fix.
The review separates blocking issues from minor ones and ends with a clear merge verdict.

The fixes use FluentValidation 12 APIs: NotNull() before SetValidator, WithErrorCode after each validator, RuleLevelCascadeMode or .Cascade(CascadeMode.Stop) (not CascadeMode.StopOnFirstFailure), and ValidateAsync with the token. The review does not recommend FluentValidation.AspNetCore or another auto-validation package.
